description: Run and test mobile apps beside your BB thread, using the same screen as your agent. Capture up to the last 30 seconds of iOS video with input, app-log, and matching crash events. Hand control explicitly between you and your agent, with one controlling thread per device. Requires BB 0.46+, an Apple Silicon Mac with Xcode’s iOS platform and Node.js 20+ for iOS; Android screenshot previews need an installed SDK and AVD.
